data.define: Slang for something excellent or stylish.

misuse.text: Don't yell 'fire' in a crowded room.

data.l1_hook: Regarde mes nouvelles baskets ! Elles sont "fire".

native.tip: “fire” = trop stylé. Exemple: “Those sneakers are fire!”
